run_update_data: run the script to update schematic triples to filters in all data files in a folder
check_schematic: check if a nested dictionary contains a schematic key recursively
check_schematics_triples: check if a nested dictionary contains a schematic key with triples inside it
update_schematics: update a nested dictionary by moving schematic triples into a filters key
review_update_data: review the update_data function that walks a folder and rewrites data files with updated schematics
